title: Design System: VC Scout — Miura-Fold Deployment

headline.purpose: One h2 per slide; heroes scale to clamp(30px,3.8vw,52px). text-wrap: balance.

strap.purpose: Single subtitle line under the wordmark; Chakra Petch 500.

body.purpose: One explanatory paragraph per slide; faded ink; max-width 66ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono spec blocks, sources, chart captions (9–10.5px in SVG/canvas); bold runs flip to ink 700.

shadows.name: foil-packet
shadows.purpose: Spine packet — the only shadows in the system belong to gold foil surfaces.

shadows.name: foil-packet-3d
shadows.purpose: Title-rig packet at the deployment hinge.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Fold-in entrances, spine slide-away, Q&A bottom sheet — the sheet settling flat.

motion.name: ease-exit
motion.purpose: Outgoing slide folding away (rotateX 9deg, translateY -2.5%, fade).

motion.name: ease-out-cubic
motion.purpose: All rAF chart draws and the title deployment.

motion.name: stagger-fold
motion.purpose: Per-element transition-delay in choreograph(), document order.

motion.name: duration-deploy
motion.purpose: Title-only 3D Miura deployment: 9 strips rotateY ±78°→±6°, camera rotateX 24°→10°.

motion.name: draw0-delay
motion.purpose: Chart draw waits for the fold-in to land; runs immediately when body.reduced.

motion.name: reduced-contract
motion.purpose: Transitions nulled, folds flat, tweens jump to end state, all slides pre-entered at boot for print/instant nav.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Spine hidden, single column, bottom rail becomes sole navigation, canvases in-flow.

breakpoints.name: short
breakpoints.purpose: Hero heads compact so charts clear them.

breakpoints.name: print
breakpoints.purpose: All slides sequential at 7.4in/page, flat folds, spine/rail/HUD/grain hidden; beforeprint pre-renders every chart in reduced mode.

components.name: Ink Tag
components.description: Sheared annotation parallelogram for statements; the inner span counter-skews so text stays upright.
components.html: STRIP = CV R² · DIAMOND = TEST R²
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; background: #0A0A0A; color: #F7F7F7; font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 4px 12px 3px; transform: skewX(-14deg); } .ds-tag > span { display: inline-block; transform: skewX(14deg); }

components.name: Gold Tag
components.description: The headline-finding tag — foil gold surface, ink text. One per composition.
components.css: .ds-tag-gold { display: inline-block; background: #D4AF37; color: #0A0A0A; font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 4px 12px 3px; transform: skewX(-14deg); } .ds-tag-gold > span { display: inline-block; transform: skewX(14deg); }

components.name: Outline Tag
components.description: Statistical-footnote tag: transparent with a crease border and faded-ink text.
components.html: n < 30 ROWS = LOW CONFIDENCE, RENDERED PART-FOLDED
components.css: .ds-tag-line { display: inline-block; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #B9B6AE; color: #4B4B47; font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 4px 12px 3px; transform: skewX(-14deg); } .ds-tag-line > span { display: inline-block; transform: skewX(14deg); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Explorer toggle: crease-bordered parallelogram; selected state fills solid ink (gold is not spent on chips).
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid #B9B6AE; background: #F7F7F7; color: #4B4B47; font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 5px 10px 4px; transform: skewX(-14deg); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.18s, background 0.18s, color 0.18s; } .ds-chip > span { display: inline-block; transform: skewX(14deg); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8A6D1C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip--on { background: #0A0A0A; border-color: #0A0A0A; color: #F7F7F7; }

components.name: Rail Cell
components.description: Fold-map navigation cell (M-01…M-17): active is gold with deep-gold border; visited carries a gold-tinted warm gradient.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; text-align: left; background: #F7F7F7; border: 1px solid #B9B6AE; color: #4B4B47; font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 6px 10px 5px; transform: skewX(-14deg); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s, border-color 0.18s; } .ds-rail > * { display: inline-block; transform: skewX(14deg); } .ds-rail .ds-rail-id { font-weight: 700; color: #0A0A0A; min-width: 38px; } .ds-rail:hover { border-color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-rail:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8A6D1C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail--active { background: #D4AF37; border-color: #B7952C; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-rail--active .ds-rail-id { color: #3D3212; } .ds-rail--seen { background: linear-gradient(105deg, #F1E9CF, #F7F7F7 60%); border-color: #B7952C; }

components.name: Ledge
components.description: Annotation card: crease border, cut corners, translucent sheet fill; spec label → display value → mono note.
components.html:
CHAMPION · GRADIENT BOOSTING
0.303
Audited test R² on 1,057 rows — the smaller number we kept.
components.css: .ds-ledge { border: 1px solid #B9B6AE; background: rgba(247,247,247,0.93); padding: 12px 14px; max-width: 300px; clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px); font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; } .ds-ledge-k { font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #4B4B47; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-ledge-v { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.1; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-ledge-n { font-size: 10px; color: #4B4B47; margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Gold Packet
components.description: Signature identity block (spine header, title hinge, close). In the deck the gold carries a raster foil-texture tile via background-blend-mode: multiply; approximated here with a gradient.
components.css: .ds-packet { display: inline-block; background: #D4AF37 linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(183,149,44,0.35) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.18) 38%, rgba(183,149,44,0.3) 72%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 100%); color: #0A0A0A; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 14px 16px 12px; clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(10,10,10,0.18); } .ds-packet small { display: block; font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-top: 3px; color: #3D3212; }

components.name: Verdict Stamp
components.description: Hypothesis verdict: display type in a 2.5px border, rotated -3° like a hand-inked impression. ok = text-gold, part = faded ink, no = correction red.
components.html: SUPPORTED PARTIAL DISPROVEN
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; border: 2.5px solid #0A0A0A; color: #0A0A0A; padding: 3px 10px; transform: rotate(-3deg); margin-right: 10px; } .ds-stamp--ok { border-color: #8A6D1C; color: #8A6D1C; } .ds-stamp--part { border-color: #4B4B47; color: #4B4B47; } .ds-stamp--no { border-color: #B3372B; color: #B3372B; }

components.name: Spec Slider
components.description: Explorer range input: hairline crease track with a sheared foil-gold thumb (the one input that earns gold).
components.html: <input type="range" class="ds-slider" min="0" max="1000" value="620" aria-label="Funding">
components.css: .ds-slider { width: 260px; appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; height: 3px; background: #B9B6AE; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 26px; height: 17px; background: #D4AF37; border: 1px solid #B7952C; transform: skewX(-14deg); cursor: ew-resize; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(10,10,10,0.3); } .ds-slider::-moz-range-thumb { width: 26px; height: 17px; background: #D4AF37; border: 1px solid #B7952C; border-radius: 0; cursor: ew-resize; } .ds-slider:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8A6D1C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Q&A Cell
components.description: Folded backup-detail button on the close slide; hover inks the border and text, click opens the bottom-sheet panel.
components.css: .ds-qa { border: 1px solid #B9B6AE; background: #F1EFE9; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'B612 Mono', monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #4B4B47; transform: skewX(-14deg); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.18s, color 0.18s; } .ds-qa > span { display: inline-block; transform: skewX(14deg); } .ds-qa:hover { border-color: #0A0A0A; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-qa:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8A6D1C; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The system treats every surface as one sheet of engineered paper: a deployable Miura-ori sheet that unfolds from a hand-sized gold packet into a full framework. Content arrives by unfolding — elements hinge in from a fold, slides leave by folding away, and one authored 3D deployment moment (the title rig) establishes the metaphor that everything else quotes quietly. The world is bright, papery, and precise: sheet-white ground under near-black ink, with foil gold reserved for the packet, the champion, and the active position. It explicitly refuses the category default — the dark stat-tile analytics keynote — and it is recognizable with all content removed: the paper grain, the faint crease lattice, and the sheared parallelogram silhouette carry the identity alone.

Two typefaces split the voice. Chakra Petch's angular, fold-cut letterforms carry titles, big numbers, and verdicts; B612 Mono — an aerospace cockpit face — carries everything else, so annotations read like spec labels printed on the sheet's selvage. Density is editorial, not dashboard: one headline per screen, generous column gaps, hairline crease borders instead of boxes, and confidence caveats staged as visible geometry (thin samples literally render part-folded).
keyCharacteristics: Sheet-white paper ground with SVG-noise grain and a faint mountain/valley crease lattice
Foil gold as surface material (packet, champion, active cell) — never as body text
Every control is a sheared parallelogram; every card has cut corners; radius is always 0
Chakra Petch display + B612 Mono spec labels; charts speak entirely in mono
Fold-in motion grammar with one authored 3D deployment moment; full reduced-motion/static/print contract
Honesty rendered visually: low-n data part-folded, corrections in red→gold, verdict stamps

rules.name: The Foil Rule
rules.body: Gold is a surface, never body text. Text sitting on gold is ink or on-gold ink (#3D3212); gold-colored text on light ground is always text-gold (#8A6D1C), never #D4AF37.

rules.name: The One Champion Rule
rules.body: In any chart, exactly one element wears foil gold — the champion, the anomaly, the active cell. Everything else is chart ink. Red appears only when something is wrong on purpose.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrows or kicker labels above headings, ever. Headings open the slide; identification lives in the rail, HUD, and spec blocks below.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Chakra Petch states; B612 Mono annotates. If a number is a verdict it is display-weight; if it is evidence it is mono. All text inside charts is mono.

rules.name: The Foil-Casts-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it isn't gold, it doesn't cast a shadow. Paper is flat; only the foil packet and foil controls lift off the sheet.

rules.name: The Counter-Skew Rule
rules.body: Any text inside a sheared container must be wrapped and counter-skewed. Letterforms are never italicized by the shear.

rules.name: The Part-Folded Rule (LOW N)
rules.body: Segments with n < 30 render part-folded: fills drop to ~45% alpha (gold) / ~35% (ink), labels to 62% opacity, values carry a LOW N suffix in text-gold, and tooltips repeat the flag. Low confidence is geometry, not a footnote.

rules.name: The One-Deployment Rule
rules.body: The full 3D deployment (nine chained strips unfolding over 2.1s from the gold packet) is authored once, on the title. Every other slide only quotes it via the fold-in entrance.

dos: Do keep gold scarce and material: one gold element per chart, gold surfaces only via foil-gold (+ texture on packets), gold text only via text-gold (#8A6D1C).
Do shear every control −14° and counter-skew its label; draw every bar as a parallelogram with a 4–16px sheared end.
Do cut corners (45°, 8–16px, opposing corners) on containers instead of rounding; border-radius stays 0 everywhere.
Do set all chart annotations in B612 Mono at 9–10.5px uppercase faded ink, and all verdict numbers in Chakra Petch 700.
Do render n < 30 segments part-folded (reduced alpha + "LOW N" suffix in text-gold) wherever thin data appears.
Do give every animation a fold semantics (something unfolds, refolds, or deploys) and a correct instant end-state under body.reduced, ?static=1, and print.
Do keep the sheet present on full-bleed surfaces: paper grain plus the 76°/−38° crease lattice at ~0.55 opacity.
donts: Don't use #D4AF37 as text on light ground, or spend gold on selection states that ink can carry (chips select in ink).
Don't add kickers or eyebrow labels above headings — the No-Kicker Rule is a world invariant.
Don't introduce icons, emoji, or glyph fonts; controls are text parallelograms.
Don't cast shadows from paper — shadows belong to foil-gold surfaces only.
Don't rebuild the dark stat-tile analytics look this world refuses: no dark ground, no rounded stat cards, no chart-library defaults; charts are hand-drawn SVG/canvas from embedded data.
Don't re-run the full 3D deployment outside an authored hero moment; ambient motion is limited to the fold-in entrance and chart draws.
